title_original: Closing the Cyber Skills Gap with 300 Academic Partnerships
description: How 300 Academic Partnerships Are Helping Close the Cyber Skills Gap Check Point’s SecureAcademy has reached 300 academic partnerships across more than 80 countries, connecting educational institutions with industry-aligned cyber security training and resources. While the milestone reflects the program’s continued growth, it also highlights a broader shift: educational institutions are increasingly looking for ways to align cyber security education with the skills employers need today. Turning Classrooms into Career Pathways Organizations worldwide continue to face a shortage of cyber security professionals, while educational institutions are under pressure to keep pace with rapidly evolving technologies and threats. title_original: Infostealers Are Targeting AI: What Aokigahara Infostealer Reveals About the New Developer Attack Surface
description: AI assistants have quickly become part of everyday work, particularly for developers. Tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and GitHub Copilot increasingly sit alongside source code, cloud environments and other sensitive business resources, making the credentials and sessions connected to these tools increasingly important to protect. New research from Check Point Research (CPR) into the Aokigahara infostealer shows how attackers are adapting to this shift. The malware specifically collects authentication files, session data and configuration files associated with popular AI applications and development tools. The significance goes beyond gaining access to an AI account. If stolen credentials or session tokens […]The postInfostealers Are Targeting AI: What Aokigahara Infostealer Reveals About the New Developer Attack Surfaceappeared first onCheck Point Blog.
